`contenteditable` is **not** a strict boolean attribute – it accepts three string values: | Value | Meaning | |-------|---------| | `"true"` | The element is editable. | | `"false"` | The element is not editable. | | `"plaintext-only"` | The element is editable, but only plain text can be entered (no formatting, no HTML). | So when you receive the value `"plaintext-only"` you should **pass that exact string** to the attribute. It is already a valid value, and you do **not** need to convert it to `"true"` or `"false"`. ```html
